_transport_note: sse forces the Codex provider onto HTTP/SSE instead of the WebSocket. The Codex WS rejects large requests (close 1009 'message too big') and auto-mode then blows the hardcoded 10s SSE-header fallback timeout — 'Codex SSE response headers timed out after 10000ms'. SSE is a plain HTTP POST with no frame-size cap, so large coding payloads go through. Values: sse|websocket|websocket-cached|auto.
_packages_note: Third-party extensions are NOT listed here. setup-pi.sh runs tools/install-pi-extensions.sh, which `pi install`s the pinned set from third-party-extensions.txt and fills this array. Single source of truth is the manifest.
